title: search_tank_items

source_ids.description: Registered source keys (reg.sources), shown after « · » next to the name in Tank's messages and results, e.g. S29 or S32.

description: Search collected source items by text over at most the preceding 90 days, returning at most 20 matching documents with their source, URL, observation time and excerpt. This queries stored observations without external network requests. Read the full item before citing an excerpt or deciding that two items describe the same event.
